# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P6](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P6](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is described as fat and stout for her age as a child. She has a malicious, smirk-prone countenance, frequently giggling or smiling maliciously at the misfortunes or embarrassments of others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)_

## Personality

Josie is malicious, vain, arrogant, and fond of envious or spiteful remarks. She is competitive, insensitive, and enjoys daring others into dangerous or humiliating situations. Despite her disagreeable nature, she is fearless in undertaking physical dares such as walking narrow fences, though she is easily disgruntled when outdone.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P7](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0007), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Traits

- Malicious  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)</sub>
- Spiteful and envious  <sub>[v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v3 c16 P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003)</sub>
- Conceited and arrogant  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- Agile at walking board fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful at walking board fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To outshining her schoolmates and excel over her peers socially and academically  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye grew up in Avonlea as part of the Pye family. At Avonlea School, she frequently cheated, sneered at others, and clashed with Anne Shirley, once cheating during a spelling match and mocking Anne's red hair. At a party at Diana Barry's house, Josie successfully walked a high board fence to show off, then dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Josie later attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne, preparing for a teacher's license, though she claimed she attended merely for 'education's sake' as her wealthy father did not require her to work. Later, she went on to Redmond College with the Avonlea cohort, where she maintained her sharp-tongued reputation and continued making catty remarks about her classmates.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
